SELECT -- 投递数统计 COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE student_id = #{studentId}), 0) AS total_applications, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND application_status = 0), 0) AS pending_applications, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND application_status = 1), 0) AS passed_applications,
-- 面试数统计 COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview WHERE student_id = #{studentId}), 0) AS total_interviews, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND interview_status = 1), 0) AS scheduled_interviews, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND interview_status = 2), 0) AS completed_interviews,
-- 收藏数统计 COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_favorite WHERE student_id = #{studentId}), 0) AS total_favorites,
-- 简历数统计和默认简历ID COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume WHERE student_id = #{studentId}), 0) AS total_resumes, (SELECT id FROM resume WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1) AS default_resume_id,
-- 头像 (SELECT head_image FROM student WHERE id = #{studentId}) AS head_image,
-- 简历完整度计算（必填字段：personalInfo, educationBackground, workExperience, skills, selfIntroduction） CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume WHERE student_id = #{studentId}) > 0 THEN ROUND( (SELECT AVG( CASE WHEN personal_info IS NOT NULL AND personal_info != '' AND education_background IS NOT NULL AND education_background != '' AND work_experience IS NOT NULL AND work_experience != '' AND skills IS NOT NULL AND skills != '' AND self_introduction IS NOT NULL AND self_introduction != '' THEN 100 WHEN personal_info IS NOT NULL AND personal_info != '' AND education_background IS NOT NULL AND education_background != '' AND work_experience IS NOT NULL AND work_experience != '' AND skills IS NOT NULL AND skills != '' THEN 80 WHEN personal_info IS NOT NULL AND personal_info != '' AND education_background IS NOT NULL AND education_background != '' AND work_experience IS NOT NULL AND work_experience != '' THEN 60 WHEN personal_info IS NOT NULL AND personal_info != '' AND education_background IS NOT NULL AND education_background != '' THEN 40 WHEN personal_info IS NOT NULL AND personal_info != '' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END ) FROM resume WHERE student_id = #{studentId}), 0 ) ELSE 0 END AS resume_completeness
